The Ping Pong Collection

Well-loved playing surfaces, reimagined for the spaces around the game.

Premium Paddle Rack

More space for the game: paddle display and dedicated ball storage in one striking piece.

Drink Shelf

A retired table surface transformed into a warm, modern shelf for drinks, game nights, and good company.

Ping Pong Scoreboard

Flip-number scoring, hardwood details, and a best-of-five indicator bring classic character to game night.

The Billiards Collection

From the pool hall to the home. Retired slate and billiard balls, reimagined.

Slate Bar Table

An authentic pool-table slate top with chiseled edges, paired with a crafted solid-oak base.

Slate Coasters

Hand-finished slate coasters, with billiard-inspired designs or personalized engraving.

Billiard Ball Bottle Stoppers

Every instrument
deserves an encore.

Furniture, accessories, and art made from retired instruments.

The Piano Collection

Once part of the music. Now objects that give old piano keys a new purpose.

Piano Plate Console Table

An original cast-iron piano plate and reclaimed hardwood top become a sculptural console table, bringing musical heritage to entryways and living spaces.

Piano Key Wine Key

A reclaimed piano key becomes a distinctive corkscrew, finished with brass and steel.

Piano Key Wine Stopper

A reclaimed piano key becomes an elegant wine stopper with polished metal and a secure seal.

Mozart Piano Wall Art

A framed tribute to Mozart’s Piano Sonata No. 16, with piano keys, musical notation, and a commemorative plaque.

Built before.
Reimagined again.

Construction and industrial materials with a story to tell. Honest textures and useful forms, given another life.

The Building Materials Collection

Three Bottle Wine Rack

White oak salvaged from a shipping crate becomes a sculptural home for three bottles. Rich grain, original markings, and a simple, substantial form bring warmth and character to the everyday ritual of pouring a glass.

Architectural Display Tray

Metal salvaged from an old home finds a new purpose. Paired with a warm wood center, exposed hardware, and a dark base, it becomes a distinctive platform for candles, keepsakes, and everyday objects.

Wood Serving Tray

Salvaged wood becomes a distinctive serving tray, with warm natural grain, black iron ring handles, and metal corner details. A gathering piece with a past.

Timber Candle Holder

Weathered construction timber, natural rope accents, and five glass votives become a warm centerpiece, bringing the character of reclaimed wood to the table.

Timber Floating Shelf

Salvaged timber becomes a floating shelf, preserving the weathered grain, saw marks, and character of its former life.

Timber Display Shelf

Reclaimed wood takes a sculptural turn, creating a distinctive wall display for plants, ceramics, and treasured objects.
